Hana (Finance Ops): StrataMeter sent a renewal that mixes a 12mo token commit, optional seats, and a new 'burst' overage tier. Can procurement/eng/legal review before we respond?
Peter (Procurement): On it. Need SKU list, prepaid annual vs monthly math, migration credit details, and cancellation/refund terms.
Iris (Platform): Usage snapshot: 3mo avg ~530M tokens/mo, 95th ~820M. Heavy endpoints: /generate and /embed. We require per-api-key attribution and a webhook example to validate ingestion.
Mika (StrataMeter Sales): Quick summary: tiers: STR_COMMIT_300=$1,900/mo, STR_COMMIT_800=$4,000/mo, STR_COMMIT_1.5B=$8,500/mo. Seats optional: STR_SEAT_10=$700/mo. PAYG $0.0075/1k tokens. Migration credit: up to 14% of first-year commit for 12mo commits, applied over first 12 invoices. Annual prepay gets 7% off. Burst overage: extra 15% surcharge only when >150% of commit in a single day. SLA: 99.9% enterprise.
Mika (StrataMeter Sales): Webhook sample: POST /hooks/usage {"customer_id":"rw-900","ts":"2025-12-20T10:12:01Z","tokens":1240,"route":"/generate","api_key":"svc-prod-2","req_id":"r_abc"} and we provide monthly CSV export for reconciliation.
Dana (Legal): From legal: data retention for raw request bodies, purge-on-termination, DPA and subprocessor list, explicit 30-day non-auto-renew opt-out, and termination penalty cap.
Mika (StrataMeter Sales): Default raw retention 45 days; billing metadata 7 years. We can add purge-on-termination and provide DPA + SOC2 on request. Termination: 60-day notice; prepaid refunds only in enterprise addendum.
Hana (Finance Ops): Good. Peter can you run a 2yr TCO for monthly commit vs annual prepay including migration credit? Also ask Mika to provide a sample invoice showing migration credit line and PO/Net30 fields.
Peter (Procurement): Will run TCO and schedule a 30m sync with StrataMeter. Mika  can you do Thu 9am PT?
Mika (StrataMeter Sales): Thu 9am PT works. I'll upload SKU sheet, sample invoice PDF, DPA, webhook schema, and CSV spec by EOD Wednesday.
Iris (Platform): I'll validate webhook + CSV once uploaded and confirm route->SKU mapping.
Hana (Finance Ops): Thanks everyone  we'll close once the packet and TCO are in.
